about_item: 【REALISTIC MAPLE LEAF WREATH】 The 7 different colors of maple leaves make this fall garland look even more natural. From deep green to vibrant orange, it resembles real fallen leaves, creating a harmonious blend of colors that warms any room. Flower garland is the perfect festive decoration for both indoor and outdoor use.

【PACKAGE CONTENTS】 You will receive 6 individual artificial maple leaf garlands, each 5.6ft. You can weave two garlands together to make them look fuller, or connect two garlands end-to-end to extend the length. These versatile garlands can be used to create a stunning wreath or to decorate various spaces, adding a touch of autumnal charm to your home.

【HIGH QUALITY】 The multi-coloured maple leaves are made of high quality silk fabric, while the stems are made of high quality plastic. Easy to clean and maintain, these leaves feature beautiful vein details. The floral garland can be reused, so you don't have to worry about the leaves being damaged by wind, rain, or sun.

【VERSATILE USE】 This fall garland is perfect for Thanksgiving, fireplaces, door decorations, holidays, and dinners. It can also be used as hanging plants to adorn wedding arches, dining tables, balconies, swings, stair railings, and more. Whether indoors or outdoors, this artificial garland adds a touch of autumn charm to any setting, making it an ideal choice for a variety of festive and decorative purposes.

【WARM REMINDER】 If you encounter any issues during the purchase of our faux garland, please feel free to contact us. We are here to provide you with a satisfactory solution. Party Joy is dedicated to offering our customers a great shopping experience. Your satisfaction is our top priority, and we will do our utmost to ensure that you are completely happy with our products and services.

summary.text: Customers find the fall garland to be of good quality and appreciate its vibrant colors, with one customer noting it's an affordable way to decorate for fall. The garland receives positive feedback for its appearance as a beautiful way to mark the season, and customers love their autumn decorations, with one mentioning it's perfect for neutral boho style. The fullness and durability receive mixed reviews - while some say it has the right amount of leaves to look full, others note it's not as full as shown in photos, and while some find the leaves sturdy, others report the garland breaks easily. Several customers mention an unpleasant smell.

authors_reviews.title: Looks Great… Until the Cats Discover It
authors_reviews.text: This fall maple leaf garland looks really nice and adds a great seasonal touch. The colors are vibrant, the length is good for decorating, and the quality feels solid. It hangs easily and holds its shape well. The only downside is that the cats absolutely love tearing it apart — but that’s not the garland’s fault. As décor, it does exactly what it should.
authors_reviews.author: Brian C

authors_reviews.title: Beautiful! Buy them !!

authors_reviews.title: Rinse before outdoor use to prevent color bleeding!
authors_reviews.text: I bought these to add some festive beauty around the door outside my condo complex. The neighbors love it as much as I do. Exactly what I wanted in a garland, definitely looks best with two strands together side by side if you want a more thick/full look, but they seemed pretty good as a single strand as well, depending on what you are looking for. The colors are great and I love that there are such a variety so they look more realistic. I shook them all around in multiple ways and I did not have any leaves ever fall off so the quality seems great. The only reason I deducted one star is because, as other reviewers have mentioned, I had to do the extra steps of taking each strand and running it under cold water in my tub to remove excess color so that it would not bleed when it rains outside. I guess that only matters if you plan to use this outside. I took each strand and ran it under the cold tap in the tub and agitated it around a bit and then use my handheld showerhead to ensure there was no more dye. There was not as much color coming off as I expected based on the reviews but I assume it is because other people filled the tub with water and then soaked all of them together, which I did not do. After a quick rinse, I put them in a large garment bag and put them in the dryer on the gentle/low heat cycle for about 20 minutes.
authors_reviews.author: MissMolly

authors_reviews.title: Fun, festive, fall decor!
authors_reviews.text: These maple leaf garlands were a fun and affordable way to decorate for fall. The leaves are obviously artificial when viewed up close, but once displayed, they looked festive and added great color to my home.I used them in several different areas, including above windows and around my fireplace. The garlands were easy to shape and arrange, and I was able to tuck the ends behind other decorations so they blended in nicely.The leaves have a nice mix of fall colors, and the strands were full enough to make an impact without needing a lot of extra decorating. I used them in several different areas of my home, which made them very versatile. The colors were bright and vibrant and showed up well both during the day and with decorative lighting at night. They also arrived without any strong chemical or plastic smell, which I appreciated. Overall, I was very happy with how they looked and would use them again for seasonal decorating.
authors_reviews.author: Lizzy Platt

authors_reviews.title: Good value
authors_reviews.text: These are so cute and I plan on putting them on top of my cabinets. Only down fall, when I took them out of the package it had a funky smell but didnt last too long.
authors_reviews.author: LeLe

authors_reviews.title: Something’s fishy here
authors_reviews.text: Purchased these last year and loved them. They’re reasonably priced, pretty, and have held up well. I loved them enough to order more this year. When I opened my garlands this year, they smelled pungently of fish. Could I have febreezed and aired them out? Maybe? Was I willing to try? Nope, too grossed out. Returned and lost my trust. Sad day.
authors_reviews.author: Kelly French

authors_reviews.title: Great quality!
authors_reviews.text: Quick shipping and came nicely packaged. Pieces are of great quality, nice vibrant colors. Can’t wait to decorate my porch.
authors_reviews.author: Bernice
